image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dessert plate featuring a scoop of white ice cream (likely vanilla) in the center. To the left is a dollop of whipped cream or soft serve. Two rectangular pieces of dark, textured biscotti or cookie stand upright behind the ice cream. Several red raspberries are scattered around the base, sitting in a pool of amber-colored syrup or sauce. The plate is white with concentric ridged detailing on the rim.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the two upright cookie pieces appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper details of the raspberries. The internal crumb structure lacks fine definition, looking somewhat like fused clay rather than baked dough.
The whipped cream dollop lacks distinct piping ridges or aerated peaks. It looks more like a solid lump of soft plastic or melted wax than aerated cream, lacking the expected fragile micro-structure.
The concentric ridges on the plate rim show slight inconsistency in spacing and curvature on the left side, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI-generated circular objects.
